description: The new safe-integer regression invokes the CommonJS renderScoreCards export only, so it cannot detect that renderPanelPage emits a browser script with an undeclared roundedScoreValue dependency. This leaves the required canonical safe-integer UI boundary unguarded in its real delivery path despite the module-level test passing.

evidence.snippet: The regression calls renderScoreCards({ organs }) directly and asserts doesNotThrow; it neither calls renderPanelPage nor executes its emitted score renderer.
evidence.testName: Fresh Node VM reproduction of the renderPanelPage inline score script rejected the same canonical model with ReferenceError: roundedScoreValue is not defined.
